text: 金十数据9月14日讯，今日A股三大指数维持震荡。截至收盘，沪指跌0.07%，深证成指跌0.64%，创业板指跌1.1%。沪深两市成交额1.63万亿，较上一个交易日缩量3427亿。盘面上，全市场超3100只个股上涨。培育钻石板块全天强势，英诺激光涨超15%，黄河旋风涨停；CRO板块活跃，近岸蛋白、万邦医药20%涨停；MLCC概念逆势走强，双星新材等涨停；数据安全概念走高，博汇科技、永信至诚20%涨停。另外，PCB概念、小金属概念、消费电子、汽车整车等板块涨幅居前；粮食概念、旅游概念、煤炭、养殖业、国防军工等板块跌幅居前。
text_en: Jinshi Data, September 14 - Today the three major A-share indices maintained a volatile trend. As of the close, the Shanghai Composite Index fell 0.07%, the Shenzhen Component Index fell 0.64%, and the ChiNext Index fell 1.1%. Combined turnover in the Shanghai and Shenzhen markets was 1.63 trillion yuan, a decrease of 342.7 billion yuan from the previous trading day. In terms of market performance, more than 3,100 stocks across the market rose. The lab-grown diamond sector was strong all day, with Inno Laser up more than 15% and Huanghe Whirlwind hitting the daily limit up; the CRO sector was active, with Nearshore Protein and Wanbang Pharmaceutical hitting the 20% daily limit up; the MLCC concept strengthened against the trend, with Shuangxing New Materials and others hitting the daily limit up; the data security concept moved higher, with Bohui Technology and Yongxin Tocean hitting the 20% daily limit up. In addition, the PCB concept, minor metals concept, consumer electronics, and automobile whole vehicles sectors were among the top gainers; the grain concept, tourism concept, coal, livestock farming, and national defense and military industry sectors were among the top decliners.
